_context.activity.buildingCoworkers: What the onboarding is doing right now: building several AI coworkers, and how many are done.
_context.activity.runningTool: What the coworker is doing right now. {tool} is the name of a step, e.g. 'Web Search'.
_context.activity.waitingOn: The coworker waits for another coworker it called. {name} is that coworker's name.
_context.activity.waitingOnSubCoworkers: The coworker waits for the sub-tasks it delegated, and how many are done.
_context.agentChat.selectModel: Shown under the message box when the user tries to send before an AI model is picked. The model menu sits under the message box.
_context.attachments.fileFallback: Stands for an attachment with no file name.
_context.attachments.openMore: Accessible label of the last tile of an album: {count} more images or videos that did not fit.
_context.attachments.position: Position of the file shown among the message's files, e.g. '2 / 5'.
_context.attachments.progressWithEta: Upload progress. {eta} is an already formatted time left, e.g. '12s left'.
_context.brainChange.undone: {title} is the title of a Brain page whose change was undone.
_context.brainProposal.create: {title} is the title of a page an agent proposes to add to the company Brain (the shared knowledge base).
_context.brainProposal.edit: {title} is the title of the Brain page an agent proposes to change.
_context.budget.connectProvider.body: Follows another sentence saying the credits ran out.
_context.budget.or: Separator between two ways out, shown in uppercase.
_context.budget.ownConnection.body: {plan} is the name of an AI subscription the user connected, e.g. 'Claude' or 'ChatGPT'. Follows another sentence.
_context.budget.preTrial.body: {credits} is an already formatted amount of credit, e.g. '$5 of credit'.
_context.budget.runOn: Button. {plan} is the name of an AI subscription, e.g. 'Claude'.
_context.budget.subscribe.description: {credits} is an already formatted amount of credit included in the plan.
_context.budget.title: Header of the notice shown when the workspace's Rerun credits (prepaid AI usage) ran out.
_context.budget.trial.continueWithPro: {price} is an already formatted monthly price, e.g. '$49'. 'Pro' is the plan's name.
_context.budget.trial.useMyPlan: Followed by two buttons: Claude and ChatGPT.
_context.budget.usedUp.trial: {credits} is an already formatted amount of credit.
_context.compaction.recovered: {tokens} is an already formatted number of AI tokens freed.
_context.compaction.running: The AI is summarizing the older part of the conversation to free room in its memory.
_context.composer.editor.hint: Keyboard shortcut hint in the full-screen message editor. Keep 'Cmd + Enter' as is.
_context.composer.link.open: Verb: opens a link typed in the message box, in a new tab.
_context.composer.placeholder: Empty message box of the chat.
_context.context.cached: AI input tokens read from the cache.
_context.context.title: Header of a hover card: how much of the AI model's context window (memory) the conversation uses.
_context.draft.label: Header of a block holding a text the user will copy and send elsewhere (an email, a post).
_context.hitlCue.question: Pill at the bottom of the chat when the coworker waits for an answer further up the thread.
_context.installGate.facts: Under the coworker's name before its setup: {apps} is the number of apps to connect, {minutes} a rough setup duration in minutes.
_context.installGate.inProgressHint: The coworker's setup already runs in another conversation.
_context.mcpServer.customWithHost: {host} is the domain of a custom MCP server.
_context.mentions.coworkers: Header of the autocomplete list after typing @.
_context.mentions.skills: Header of the autocomplete list after typing /.
_context.message.branch.page: Position among alternative answers, e.g. '2 of 3'.
_context.message.regenerate: Tooltip: write this AI answer again.
_context.paidSources.count: Pill under a reply that used paid data sources.
_context.pendingHitl.goTo: Accessible label of a pill that scrolls to what the coworker is waiting for. {label} says what it waits for (e.g. 'Approval needed').
_context.promptInput.stop: Accessible label: stops the AI answer being written.
_context.promptInput.submit: Accessible label of the send button of the message box.
_context.promptInput.tooLarge: Error when attaching files. {names} lists the first one or two file names, {more} how many others were rejected (only used when {count} is above 2).
_context.providerError.fallbackTitle: Title of an error notice in the chat when the error has no specific title.
_context.providerError.switch.cta: Verb, button: switch to another AI model.
_context.question.tooManyFiles: Toast. {rejected} is the number of files left out.
_context.queued.attachmentsOnly: A queued message with files and no text.
_context.queued.badge: Badge on a message waiting to be sent after the current run.
_context.reasoning.thought: Noun: a settled reasoning step of the AI, in the list of its steps.
_context.receipt.apps.insteadOf: {name} is the app the coworker asked for; the user picked another one instead.
_context.receipt.keys.title: Header of a card listing the API keys (credentials) the user gave the coworker.
_context.receipt.status.notNow: Badge: the user declined an action the coworker asked to approve, for now.
_context.receipt.takeover.handedBackOn: The user gave control of the remote browser back to the AI coworker. {url} is the page it was on.
_context.scheduledRun.label: Divider in the thread where a scheduled (recurring) run started.
_context.scheduledRun.promptTitle: {name} is the name of the scheduled routine.
_context.screen.takeControl: Button on a mini view of the coworker's live computer screen: lets the user drive it.
_context.setupEvents.read: Badge: the notification has been read (past participle).
_context.setupEvents.schedulesOn: Badge: number of recurring schedules switched on by the setup.
_context.setupEvents.triggersOn: Badge: number of triggers (webhooks, events) switched on by the setup.
_context.steps.compacting: What the coworker is doing right now: summarizing the older conversation.
_context.steps.failed: {failed} is a number of steps that failed.
_context.steps.thinking: What the coworker is doing right now, shown animated while it reasons.
_context.subRun.earlier: Count of earlier steps hidden above the last ones.
_context.subRun.idle: Badge: the task has done nothing for {minutes} minutes.
_context.subRun.verbs.read: {summary} is the page or file read, can be empty.
_context.subRun.verbs.run: Running a shell command. {summary} is the command, can be empty.
_context.subRun.verbs.search: One step of a delegated task. {summary} is what it searches, can be empty.
_context.takeover.opened: The user took control of the browser on the AI coworker's remote computer.
_context.tool.completedIn: {duration} is an already formatted duration, e.g. '1.2s' or '300ms'.
_context.tool.error: Section header in the details of a tool call: the error it returned.
_context.tool.input: Section header in the details of a tool call: what it was called with.
_context.tool.output: Section header in the details of a tool call: what it returned.
_context.triggerPayload.payload: Header above the body a webhook received.
_context.triggerPayload.truncated: Badge: the webhook body was cut because it was too long.
_context.video.play: Accessible label. {name} is the video's file name.
_context.voice.discard: Verb, tooltip: throws away the voice message being recorded.
_context.voice.microphone: Shown while the microphone is being opened, in the narrow bar of a question's answer. Short on purpose: it has to fit next to a waveform on a phone.
_context.voice.transcribing: Shown while a recording is being turned into words.
_context.voice.seek: Accessible label of the waveform: clicking it jumps to that point of the recording.
_context.voice.transcript: Tooltip of a button that shows the text transcribed from a voice message.
_context.webhookRun.label: Divider in the thread where an incoming webhook started a run.
_context.agentChat.continueWhereLeftOff: Message sent to the coworker in the user's name when they resume a run that was cut off. The user speaking to the coworker.
